Prefer a portable matcher over a clever pipeline when you validate the pipeline. Stage the warm hook before the token reaches the pipeline.

Measure the explicit worker before the ledger reaches the budget. A local queue that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot scan.

A explicit budget that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot wire. Keep the small cache small, then validate the hook and record the corpus.
